title: Buckle up for more body-swapping hijinks in Jumanji: Open World trailer
gist: Sony released a new trailer for Jumanji: Open World, the final film of the trilogy, opening December 25, 2026, with the game spilling into the real world and a new round of avatar swaps.

insights.claim: Jumanji: Open World, directed by Jake Kasdan, opens on Christmas Day 2026, a week after Avengers: Doomsday and Dune: Part Three, which will dominate mid-December box office.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Holiday release calendar competition; Sony positions it as family counter-programming.

insights.claim: The franchise has grossed strongly: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle earned over $960 million worldwide and spawned a similarly successful 2019 sequel.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette

insights.claim: The full main cast returns including Dwayne Johnson, Kevin Hart, Jack Black and Karen Gillan, billed as the final installment of the trilogy, with the game now breaking into the real world.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Full cast return lowers production risk.
